_comment: Factory default permission posture for a PromptAndPray install. `ask` is the desired set that setup/update set-merges into the project's .claude/settings.json; only the rules setup actually INSERTED are recorded in aiwf.config.json._aiwf.ownedAskRules, and an owned rule the operator later removes becomes a tombstone in _aiwf.suppressedAskRules and is never forced back. Foreign rules are never touched.
_allowDenyComment: `allow` and `deny` below are the FACTORY DEFAULT posture, not owned rules: a blanket Bash allow with an empty deny, so that protection comes from the explicit ask gate plus the PreToolUse hooks rather than from a brittle command allowlist. Setup applies them only when the project has no permissions block of its own; it never overwrites an existing one.
_placeholderComment: `<projectRoot>` is rendered by setup from the resolved project root. The three `git -C <projectRoot> ...` forms exist because a -C-prefixed command is a DIFFERENT match string from the bare form, and the push/merge/rebase gate must hold for every form.
_stackComment: The package-manager, migration-tool and container rules are the default set proven in a Node + SQL project. They cost nothing on a project that never runs those commands; the interview may narrow them.
